{"Implementation approach":"Preserve protocol files exactly: CMakeLists.txt, src/Main.cpp, tests/test_main.cpp. Use a thin runtime entry that demonstrates the engine deterministically and exits. Separate pure domain logic into cohesive headers under include/ with matching implementations in src/. Build a core library from domain sources, link the demo and tests to it. Tests remain headless-friendly: they include headers only, construct the engine in-memory, and validate moves, alternation, win/draw detection, and reset/history without any I/O, GUI, or network. Keep modules small and domain-specific: Board (grid and cells), Move/MoveHistory (value and auditing), WinDetector (pure rule scanning), and GameEngine (orchestration applying validated moves). Use C++17 only and CMake with add_test. Roles: Alice as Player X, Eve as Player O, and Alex as reviewer via tests.","Domain Decomposition":[["Runtime bootstrap demo of a small deterministic game","src/Main.cpp","protocol-required"],["CMake build: library + demo executable + tests + registration","CMakeLists.txt","protocol-required"],["Protocol-level automated test file","tests/test_main.cpp","automated-test"],["Common domain types: Player, CellState, GameStatus, MoveError","include/Common.h","interface"],["Board entity: dimensions, cells, safe get/set, bounds, fullness, clear","include/Board.h","domain-entity"],["Board implementation","src/Board.cpp","domain-entity"],["Move value: row, col, player","include/Move.h","domain-entity"],["Move value implementation (operators, validation helpers)","src/Move.cpp","domain-entity"],["Move history: push/pop, audit, clear","include/MoveHistory.h","domain-entity"],["Move history implementation","src/MoveHistory.cpp","domain-entity"],["Win detection: horizontal, vertical, and both diagonals scanning for five","include/WinDetector.h","pure-rule"],["Win detection implementation","src/WinDetector.cpp","pure-rule"],["Game engine: apply validated moves, alternate turns, update status, reset","include/GameEngine.h","orchestration"],["Game engine implementation","src/GameEngine.cpp","orchestration"]],"File list":["CMakeLists.txt","src/Main.cpp","tests/test_main.cpp","include/Common.h","include/Board.h","include/Move.h","include/MoveHistory.h","include/WinDetector.h","include/GameEngine.h","src/Board.cpp","src/Move.cpp","src/MoveHistory.cpp","src/WinDetector.cpp","src/GameEngine.cpp"],"Canonical File References":["CMakeLists.txt","src/Main.cpp","tests/test_main.cpp","include/Common.h","include/Board.h","include/Move.h","include/MoveHistory.h","include/WinDetector.h","include/GameEngine.h","src/Board.cpp","src/Move.cpp","src/MoveHistory.cpp","src/WinDetector.cpp","src/GameEngine.cpp"],"Data structures and interfaces":"classDiagram
    class Common {
        <<enum>> Player
        <<enum>> CellState
        <<enum>> GameStatus
        <<enum>> MoveError
    }
    class Board {
        -size_t width
        -size_t height
        -std::vector<CellState> cells
        +Board(size_t w=15, size_t h=15)
        +size_t getWidth() const
        +size_t getHeight() const
        +bool inBounds(size_t r, size_t c) const
        +CellState get(size_t r, size_t c) const
        +bool set(size_t r, size_t c, CellState s)
        +bool isFull() const
        +void clear()
    }
    class Move {
        +size_t row
        +size_t col
        +Player player
        +Move(size_t r, size_t c, Player p)
        +bool operator==(const Move& other) const
    }
    class MoveHistory {
        -std::vector<Move> history
        +void push(const Move& m)
        +bool undo(Move& out)
        +const std::vector<Move>& all() const
        +void clear()
        +size_t size() const
    }
    class WinDetector {
        +static std::optional<Player> checkWin(const Board& b)
        +static bool hasFiveFrom(const Board& b, size_t r, size_t c, int dr, int dc)
    }
    class GameEngine {
        -Board board
        -Player current
        -GameStatus status
        -MoveHistory history
        +GameEngine(size_t w=15, size_t h=15)
        +const Board& getBoard() const
        +Player getCurrentPlayer() const
        +GameStatus getStatus() const
        +const MoveHistory& getHistory() const
        +MoveError applyMove(size_t r, size_t c)
        +void reset()
    }
    GameEngine --> Board
    GameEngine --> MoveHistory
    WinDetector ..> Board
    MoveHistory --> Move
    Board ..> Common
    Move ..> Common
    GameEngine ..> WinDetector
    GameEngine ..> Common","Program call flow":"sequenceDiagram
    participant M as Main
    participant GE as GameEngine
    participant B as Board
    participant WD as WinDetector
    M->>GE: construct GameEngine(15,15)
    M->>GE: applyMove(r,c) by Alice (Player X)
    GE->>B: validate inBounds & cell empty
    GE->>B: set(r,c,CellState::X)
    GE->>WD: checkWin(Board)
    WD-->>GE: none
    GE-->>M: MoveError::None, status InProgress
    M->>GE: applyMove(r,c) by Eve (Player O)
    GE->>B: validate & set
    GE->>WD: checkWin
    GE-->>M: MoveError::None
    M->>GE: repeat deterministic sequence
    WD-->>GE: winner found (Player X)
    GE-->>M: status WonX
    M-->>M: print summary and exit","Domain Mapping":[["Core types used across modules: Player, CellState, GameStatus, MoveError","include/Common.h"],["Grid management: dimensions, cells, safe coordinates Board, WinDetector, and MoveHistory; applies moves for current player, enforces alternation and game-over rules, updates GameStatus, supports reset"]],"Task list":["CMakeLists.txt","include/Common.h","include/Board.h","include/Move.h","include/MoveHistory.h","include/WinDetector.h","include/GameEngine.h","src/Board.cpp","src/Move.cpp","src/MoveHistory.cpp","src/WinDetector.cpp","src/GameEngine.cpp","src/Main.cpp","tests/test_main.cpp"],"Task Protocol Audit":{"required_files_present_exactly":true,"pm_canonical_matches_design_file_list":true,"task_list_covers_all_canonical_files":true,"logic_analysis_covers_all_canonical_files":true,"missing_from_pm_canonical":[],"missing_from_task_list":[],"missing_from_logic_analysis":[],"renamed_required_files":[],"noncanonical_file_references":[],"undeclared_file_references":[],"unexpected_additional_test_files":[],"exactly_one_protocol_test_file":true,"cpp_tests_include_headers_only":true},"File Coverage Audit":{"design_file_list_count":14,"pm_canonical_count":14,"logic_analysis_count":14,"task_list_count":14,"missing_from_pm_canonical":[],"missing_from_logic_analysis":[],"missing_from_task_list":[],"extra_in_pm_canonical":[],"extra_in_task_list":[],"coverage_passed":true},"Test Scope Plan":[["tests/test_main.cpp","basic runtime wiring via GameEngine API: construct engine, ensure initial status InProgress and current player is Player::X (Alice)"],["tests/test_main.cpp","core rule: win detection for five-in-a-row (horizontal or vertical) using alternating valid moves; assert status transitions to WonX or WonO appropriately"]],"Test Include Plan":[["tests/test_main.cpp","include/GameEngine.h"],["tests/test_main.cpp","include/Common.h"],["tests/test_main.cpp","include/Board.h"]],"Module Boundary Audit":{"core_domain_logic_modules":["src/Board.cpp","src/Move.cpp","src/MoveHistory.cpp","src/WinDetector.cpp","src/GameEngine.cpp"],"environment_dependent_modules":["src/Main.cpp"],"environment_test_coupling_risks":[],"headless_testing_risks":[]},"Architecture Collapse Audit":{"has_generic_bucket_modules":false,"generic_bucket_modules":[],"collapse_risks":[],"recommended_replacements":[],"passes_architecture_quality_gate":true},"C++ Build Link Audit":{"declared_headers_match_declared_sources":true,"tests_include_headers_only":true,"core_library_declared":true,"runtime_links_core_library":true,"test_links_core_library":true,"enable_testing_declared":true,"add_test_declared":true,"missing_interface_files":[],"undeclared_test_includes":[],"suspected_build_breakers":[],"notes":"Core library should compile from src/Board.cpp, src/Move.cpp, src/MoveHistory.cpp, src/WinDetector.cpp, src/GameEngine.cpp. src/Main.cpp must not be part of the core library. tests/test_main.cpp must not include or compile any src/*.cpp directly."},"Python Dependency Compatibility Audit":{"not_applicable":true,"uses_outdated_pins":false,"version_range_recommendations":[],"headless_test_notes":""},"Full API spec":"include/Common.h: enum class Player { X, O }; enum class CellState { Empty, X, O }; enum class GameStatus { InProgress, WonX, WonO, Draw }; enum class MoveError { None, OutOfBounds, Occupied, NotYourTurn, GameOver }.
include/Board.h: class Board { public: explicit Board(size_t w = 15, size_t h = 15); size_t getWidth() const noexcept; size_t getHeight() const noexcept; bool inBounds(size_t r, size_t c) const noexcept; CellState get(size_t r, size_t c) const; // Pre: inBounds(r,c); returns CellState::Empty/X/O. bool set(size_t r, size_t c, CellState s); // Sets cell if in-bounds and returns true; returns false if out-of-bounds. bool isFull() const noexcept; void clear(); }.
include/Move.h: struct Move { size_t row; size_t col; Player player; Move(size_t r, size_t c, Player p); bool operator==(const Move& other) const noexcept; }.
include/MoveHistory.h: class MoveHistory { public: void push(const Move& m); bool undo(Move& out); // Pops last move into out; returns false if empty. const std::vector<Move>& all() const noexcept; void clear() noexcept; size_t size() const noexcept; }.
include/WinDetector.h: class WinDetector { public: static std::optional<Player> checkWin(const Board& b); // Returns Player when a five-in-a-row is present, otherwise std::nullopt. static bool hasFiveFrom(const Board& b, size_t r, size_t c, int dr, int dc); // Helper: scans contiguous cells starting at (r,c) inclusive in direction (dr,dc). }.
include/GameEngine.h: class GameEngine { public: explicit GameEngine(size_t w = 15, size_t h = 15); const Board& getBoard() const noexcept; Player getCurrentPlayer() const noexcept; GameStatus getStatus() const noexcept; const MoveHistory& getHistory() const noexcept; MoveError applyMove(size_t r, size_t c); // Applies a move for current player at (r,c). Returns OutOfBounds if invalid coordinates; Occupied if cell not empty; NotYourTurn only if an external caller attempts to bypass alternation (tests will call only via this method which handles alternation); GameOver if status is not InProgress; None on success. void reset(); }.
Semantics: - Game starts with current player Player::X (Alice). After a successful move, alternates to Player::O (Eve). - Board cells reflect CellState::X or CellState::O based on moves. - After every successful move, WinDetector::checkWin is invoked; status becomes WonX or WonO if a five-in-a-row is found; on a full board without winner, status becomes Draw; otherwise InProgress. - MoveHistory records every successful move in order; reset() clears board, history, status, and sets current to Player::X. - No I/O, timing, or environment dependencies exist in core modules. - Include direction rules: src/*.cpp include their corresponding include/*.h and other headers as needed; tests/test_main.cpp includes declared headers only and never src/*.cpp.","Shared Knowledge":"Project builds a reusable core library from src/Board.cpp, src/Move.cpp, src/MoveHistory.cpp, src/WinDetector.cpp, src/GameEngine.cpp. Runtime entry is src/Main.cpp and is linked against the core library. tests/test_main.cpp is the only protocol test file; it includes include/GameEngine.h (and optionally include/Common.h, include/Board.h) only and links to the core library. No GUI or network is present; tests are headless-friendly and operate purely in-memory.","Execution Protocol":"Run ctest. The CMake project defines: a core library built from non-Main sources, a demo executable from src/Main.cpp linked to the core library, and a test executable from tests/test_main.cpp linked to the core library. enable_testing() and add_test() register the single protocol test. Runtime entry: src/Main.cpp. The test is non-interactive and includes declared headers only.","Anything UNCLEAR":"Default board size is assumed to be 15x15; overline or renju restrictions are not applied (simple five-in-a-row wins). If a different size or variant rules are desired, please specify."}
